branding: Use the supplied original logo unchanged. New palette is a proposed website direction, not a replacement corporate identity. The official logo is red; retain that colour. The suggested red token is approximate, not an extracted official standard. Bronze is a supporting material accent.

typography.headings: DM Sans or Manrope, confident editorial scale

motion.desktop: Material-to-room image reveal; brief controlled sticky sequence; subtle heading stagger
motion.mobile: Normal flow; short reveals, no long pinning
motion.constraints: No scroll-jacking, autoplay video or heavy WebGL required.
